name: Zenbook Duo GNOME Tools
description:
Window snapping and display controls for the ASUS Zenbook Duo: snap windows to either screen or across both while dragging, swap windows between screens (F8), compact display controls (F7), touch-keyboard placement, and pop-ups for the Zenbook Duo Linux services.

Works best with https://github.com/zakstam/zenbook-duo-linux, but the window snapping and display controls work without it.
